source_short: DISR Resources and Energy Quarterly (historical years via Geoscience Australia AECR; 2025-26 and 2026-27 from REQ Sept 2026)
source: DISR/OCE Resources and Energy Quarterly (REQ): 2017-18 from REQ Dec 2018 (via Petroleum Australia); 2018-19 from GA AECR 2021 Overview Table 5; 2019-20 from GA AECR 2022 Overview text; 2020-21 from GA AECR 2023 Overview text; 2021-22 from GA AECR 2024 Overview Table 1.5; 2022-23 from GA AECR 2025 Production and trade Table 2.2 (AEP Key Statistics 2024 shows A$92.3bn); 2023-24 from REQ Sept 2025 Table 2(2) cited in GA AECR 2026 Table 2.2; 2024-25 from REQ Sept 2025 (via Global LNG Hub summary); 2025-26 and 2026-27 forecast from REQ Sept 2026 (via IMA summary, 5 Oct 2026)
note_en: Primary REQ PDF/Excel tables could not be machine-read from this environment (industry.gov.au blocks automated fetch); values were taken from secondary/derivative publications quoting REQ. 2014-15 to 2016-17 not found. GA AECR overview chapters source these FY values to DISR REQ / DCCEEW Australian Energy Update. REQ Mar 2025 had 2023-24 at A$70bn (rounded); later REQ Sept 2025 figure of A$68.6bn used. 2025-26 is the Sept 2026 REQ estimate for the completed year; 2026-27 is a forecast lifted by higher oil-linked contract prices after the 2026 Middle East conflict.
note_zh: REQ原始PDF及Excel表格在本环境无法直接读取，数据取自引用REQ的二手发布。2014-15至2016-17财年数据缺失。GA AECR各版概览章节数据源为DISR REQ及DCCEEW《澳大利亚能源统计更新》。2023-24财年：REQ 2025年3月版为700亿澳元（取整），采用2025年9月版686亿澳元。2025-26财年为2026年9月版对已结束财年的估计值；2026-27财年为预测值，2026年中东冲突推高油价挂钩长协价格。

source: GA AECR 2021 Gas chapter (2017-18 to 2019-20, citing DISR REQ); GA AECR 2023 Gas chapter (2021-22, record 83.2 Mt); REQ March 2025 LNG table via Argus (2023-24)
note_en: 2024-25 and 2025-26 FY volumes and current REQ volume forecasts not retrievable. Calendar-year volumes are in lng_export_volume_cy.
note_zh: 2024-25、2025-26财年出口量及REQ最新出口量预测未能获取。自然年数据见lng_export_volume_cy。

source_short: Geoscience Australia AECR (from Australian Energy Update)
source: GA AECR Overview / Production and trade chapters: 2021 ed. Table 3 (2018-19), 2022 ed. (2019-20), 2023 ed. (2020-21), 2024 ed. (2021-22), 2025 ed. Table 2.1 (2022-23), 2026 ed. Table 2.1 (2023-24); based on DCCEEW Australian Energy Update
note_en: Complete FY run 2018-19 to 2023-24 in PJ; Mt not published for 2020-21, 2022-23. AECR 2023 gave 2021-22 as 4,528 PJ; later edition value 4,637 PJ used.
note_zh: 2018-19至2023-24财年能量口径连续序列；2020-21、2022-23财年未公布吨数。AECR 2023版2021-22财年为4,528 PJ，采用后续版本4,637 PJ。

note_en: Sum of crude and condensate computed from GA tables (excludes LPG). Energy terms 2024: crude 162 PJ + condensate 397 PJ. 2024 crude fell about 11% y/y. 82% of all oil production in 2024 came from North West Shelf basins (GA).

source_short: Geoscience Australia AECR 2022-2026, gas production by basin
source: Geoscience Australia, Australia's Energy Commodity Resources (AECR) 2022/2023/2024/2025/2026 editions, Gas chapter, Tables 3.1 (conventional) and 3.2 (CSG), production by basin for calendar years 2020-2024
note_en: Derived: sum of Northern Carnarvon/Roebuck, Bonaparte/Browse, Gippsland and Bass/Otway basins. Basin grouping is ours: GA does not publish an offshore/onshore split. Perth Basin (mostly onshore) is counted onshore; Otway includes minor onshore output.
note_zh: 推算值：北卡那封/Roebuck、Bonaparte/Browse、Gippsland、Bass/Otway四个盆地加总。GA未公布海上与陆上拆分，盆地归类为本表自定。珀斯盆地以陆上为主，计入陆上；Otway含少量陆上产量。

source_short: Geoscience Australia AECR 2022-2026, gas production by basin

source_short: Derived from Geoscience Australia AECR basin tables

source: ABARES Australian fisheries and aquaculture statistics 2015 (2014-15, rounded, via SeafoodSource), 2016 Table 2 (2015-16), 2017 Table 1 (2016-17), 2021 (2020-21, via Baird Maritime), 2022 (2021-22, ABARES production page); ABARES Australian fisheries and aquaculture outlook 2024 (2023-24 forecast)

Totals net out southern bluefin tuna double counting.
note_zh: ABARES已发布数据截至2023-24财年的统计报告（联邦渔业及贸易数据截至2024-25财年），本次未能获取原文；2023-24财年为2024年3月展望报告预测值。2017-18至2019-20、2022-23财年实际值缺失（2023年展望报告预测2022-23财年为36.3亿澳元）。总值已扣除南方蓝鳍金枪鱼重复计算。

label_en: Petroleum Resource Rent Tax cash receipts

source_short: Commonwealth Budget papers, BP1 Statement 5 (actuals and estimates)
source: Commonwealth Budget Paper No. 1, general government (cash) receipts tables: 2019-20 BP1 St.4 (2017-18 actual); 2021-22 BP1 St.5 Table 5.7 (2019-20 actual); Oct 2022-23 BP1 St.5 Table 5.8 (2021-22 actual); 2024-25 BP1 St.5 Table 5.7 (2022-23 actual); 2025-26 BP1 St.4 Table 4.7 (2023-24 actual); 2026-27 BP1 St.5 Table 5.7 (2024-25 actual; 2025-26 to 2029-30 estimates)
note_en: 2019-20 includes an undisclosed amount of MRRT receipts. 2026-27 Budget revised PRRT up A$400m in 2026-27 (A$1.6bn over 5 years) on higher near-term oil prices from the Middle East conflict. 2014-15 to 2016-17, 2018-19 and 2020-21 not retrieved.
note_zh: 2019-20财年含未单独披露的矿产资源租赁税（MRRT）收入。2026-27年度预算因中东冲突推高近期油价，上调2026-27财年PRRT 4亿澳元（5年累计上调16亿澳元）。2014-15至2016-17、2018-19、2020-21财年未能获取。
